title: I Built A Tool That Tracks Insider Trading
author: Ok-Consequence3599
selftext:
**5 years ago**  i came across Deep F\*cking Value and Insider Trading and ive been using it as major part of my DD every since.

(and its been working pretty well im up **45% in the past year** on my TFSA)

But openinsider always just felt laggy, missed a lot of filters and you always had to keep checking it since there wasnt an alert option. and finviz and quiver quant is missing a lot of trades.

So earlier this year i decided to build [**kestrelterminal**](http://kestrelterminal.com/) as a side project for personal use to do exactly what openinsider and other softwares couldnt.

Its free to use, but you do need a paid plan to use the alerts/strategies tab (what I used to grow my TFSA).

If you're interested in that just send me a dm and ill give you **FREE ACCESS**

Would really appreciate it if y'all could check it out and let me know what you think of it!

[**Kestrelterminal.com**](http://kestrelterminal.com/)

comments.author: rebel-capitalist
comments.body: Why we need to send DM to get access to it, mime does the exact same thing as yours and doesn’t require signup or paywalls to access it https://stocknest.app/filers/politicians

replies.author: Ok-Consequence3599
replies.body:
first off ik this is a saas you personally own. secondly and I mean this in the nicest way pleas educate yourself. "insider trades" are not politician or congress trades. these are 2 very different things. and lastly I took a look at ur saas. its missing quite a lot of features and up to date transactions compared to mine.

As for your question about paid vs free. Well to search for insider trades is absolutely free. While the paid section includes out custom alerts (with is a custom algo we've built to detect the highest profitability insider trades). Which you wont find anywhere. Only other real competitor doing this is quiver quant. and we are outperforming them by 3x (you can check the past years returns in the alerts tab for each strategy)

replies.author: Ok-Consequence3599
replies.body:
like I said you lack a ton of data. I can list tons of tickers that you have no insider data for. aswell as ur data being dated and not up to date (unlike ours which files 15 minutes after its filed on the SEC).

Unlike mine theres thousands like yours (openinsider is a way better alternative). What sets mine apart is the filters, specific cluster buy trackers, and like I said our custom Strats/algos.

Good luck on improving your software!

comments.author: krazineurons
comments.body: What's TFSA? What is the edge here with insider trading that you are able to capitalize on?

replies.author: Ok-Consequence3599
replies.body:
Tax free savings account. The edge is the people who know best about what a stock is going to do. Isn't some hedge fund, politician, day trader, or some random person on reddit. Its the people actually in charge of these companies.

And our software allows you to track when they place trades (only a 2 business day delay). And using the correct filters can help you sort through high intent trades that could potentially mean they have some insider info for them to purchase X amount of shares

replies.author: krazineurons
replies.body: Nice, so you are copying their trades and are able to find the edge. Interesting idea!
